notes: Four things that only matter on a bad day. A crash or power cut while the app was saving your backup settings could leave that file half-written — and the app then read it as "backups have never been set up" and, the next time you touched the Backup screen, saved that back over it: your backup folder and your off-site passphrase gone, and any encrypted backups in your folder unopenable on this computer. The file is now written the safe way (beside it, then renamed, keeping the previous good copy), and a settings file that cannot be read is SAID rather than silently replaced with defaults — the screen tells you nothing has been changed and not to re-enter the folder or passphrase yet, and saving is refused until it is sorted. "Proven restorable" is now about a backup you still have: the app keeps the newest ten, so the backup a drill proved a month ago had often been deleted since, while the app went on claiming it was proven — the drill now re-runs by itself when that happens. A company whose folder has been moved, renamed or deleted outside the app is no longer opened as a brand-new empty ledger under the same name (which looked exactly like total data loss and invited setting it up again over a recoverable situation): the app refuses, explains, and lets you clear the entry from the company list. And a FAILED backup attempt is now said on the dashboard the same day rather than sitting on the Backup screen for a week and a half, with the off-site copy getting its own warning. Nothing about your books changed: no migration, no posting rule, no report.
